t: Apine Bees (Subfamily Apinae) · iNaturalist
s: The Apinae are the subfamily that includes the majority of bees in the family Apidae. It includes the familiar 'corbiculate' (pollen basket) bees — bumblebees, honey bees, orchid bees, stingless bees, and the extinct genus Euglossopteryx. It also includes all but two of the groups (excluding Nomadinae and Xylocopinae) that were previously classified in the family Anthophoridae.
